question: Which ten-syllabled mantra is invoked to grant protection in the southern direction?
premises: The mantra begins with the seed syllables hrīṃ and śrīṃ.
It is identified as having ten syllables.
It is asked to protect the speaker always in the south.
inference: The ten-syllabled mantra with hrīṃ and śrīṃ protects in the south.
plain_english: May the ten-syllabled mantra beginning with hrīṃ and śrīṃ always protect me in the south.
